test_GCSGateway_create_bucket: test the GCSGateway class to verify it creates a GCS bucket using the Google Cloud Storage client
test_GCSGateway_upload_file: test the GCSGateway upload_file method to verify it uploads a local file to a GCS bucket blob
test_GCSGateway_download_file: test the GCSGateway download_file method to verify it downloads a GCS blob to a local file path
test_GCSGateway_delete_object: test the GCSGateway delete_object method to verify it deletes a blob from a specified GCS bucket
test_GCSGateway_list_objects: test the GCSGateway list_objects method to verify it lists blobs in a GCS bucket by prefix
